# P-SUP — remote Kaggle T4 deployment specification (NOT deployed)

**Design only. No kernel/notebook/metadata/training code generated, pushed or executed; no quota/auth/secret/remote API accessed.** No run is authorized. Any objective change requires explicit distinct-arm AGENTS amendment before implementing or using a deployment package.

## Prospective private package identities

Use new, arm/run-specific kernel and output IDs, never overwrite E0/E1 or prior C0/C1 deployments. Separate control/treatment state/output roots and manifests; sharing immutable inputs is allowed, sharing mutable optimizer/scaler/RNG is not. Names/slugs/revisions remain unallocated until operator review. Proposed future private package has pinned code/config/hash manifest and execution gate default false.

Required metadata: `machine_shape: NvidiaTeslaT4` (verify actual T4×2 allocation), `enable_gpu: true`, `is_private: true`. Dataset/package/assets strictly private under CC BY-NC 4.0. No new public dataset/notebook/source publication. Quota allocation/actual remaining accelerator hours must be verified before even an authorized launch; no measured time or sufficient quota is claimed now.

## Future preflight and execution sequence — do NOT run now

1. Approve the operation/existence objective and parameter-matched control, exact common contract, source/config revisions, initialization inventory, budget and durability target. Read all process checkpoints; ensure experiment-run authorization separate from setup approval.
2. Review source dependency/license and privacy inventory; construct only authorized Fold-1 FIT/SELECT/CAL/VAL input allowlist from frozen original TRAIN/VAL. TEST speakers ABA/ASI/EBVS/HJK/LXC/PNV absent physically; do not mount a cross-fold package that contains them. No original archive re-upload from laptop. Verify immutable input/package SHA and membership before model loading; training reads VM disk (`/kaggle/input`, or verified local copy), not Drive streaming.
3. Verify Kaggle CLI/auth/quota through approved official interface, actual T4 allocation, CUDA availability, FP16 AMP and pinned dependencies/source. No CPU/local training fallback on missing CUDA/quota/auth; STOP with checkpoint. Any preflight using GPU needs explicit authorization.
4. Stage via official permanent workflow `kaggle kernels push -p <reviewed-package-dir> --no-run`. Operator attaches `HF_TOKEN` in Web UI Secrets, then starts approved execution via Save & Run All. No automated secrets retrieval/login/token CLI args, no disk credential probing or environment dump. CLI monitors official kernel status/output only after authorization.
5. Each arm independently initializes original pretrained backbone frozen/eval plus matched downstream modules, states and seed. Strict assertions for contract/split/objective/control and no unintended trainable backbone/diagnosis. Verify independent RNG/scheduler/scaler states and fit/selection/calibration boundaries before first update.
6. Train only CUDA FP16 AMP on authorized remote T4; batch2/accum2, lr.001/AdamW/wd.01, warmup100 and fixed15,000-update cosine horizon as prospective spec. Cap exactly3,600 successful optimizer updates per arm; count microsteps/attempts/overflows separately. No automatic distributed/multi-GPU strategy that doubles effective batch or changes update math; approve per-GPU assignment before execution. Two T4 devices do not require concurrent arms or imply free extra budget.
7. Save atomic `last.pt`/`best.pt` each epoch and immutable exact-update fixed endpoint. Include model, optimizer, scheduler, scaler, all RNG and sampler/dataloader state, source/config/input/objective/hash metadata, update/skips/epoch/exposure and checkpoint selection evidence. Best/fixed accounting remains separate. A 3,598-update artifact is PARTIAL, never renamed3,600.
8. Immediately mirror each epoch artifact and history to approved **private** persistent Hugging Face store with temporary upload → SHA-256 readback → atomic logical publication manifest/pointer; no SYNCED from mere upload response. Preserve previous verified object until new readback succeeds. Apply existing Drive-immediate-sync policy or obtain explicit approval for HF-as-authorized-equivalent; do not silently waive it. `/kaggle/working` under20GB is ephemeral and never sole checkpoint storage.
9. Stop/fail closed on mirror corruption/failure, excessive disk, lost quota, invalid numerics, missing secrets, wrong source/split/arm or non-CUDA precision. Save interruption checkpoint and last verified persistent artifact/update/skips. Resume only same objective/run with cryptographic artifact verification and independent states; no local fallback or other-arm warm start.
10. At completion independently verify private fixed/best/last identities and predictions/checkpoint hashes, archive logs/manifest durably and release idle GPU resources. Record actual p50/p95/throughput/memory/time/cost when separately measured, not extrapolated as evidence.

## Unverified / NO-GO list

No quota, auth, T4 allocation, deployment slug, secret attachment, package membership, actual weight readback, loss/model implementation, run source pin, subtype support, capacity match, mirror target or remote recovery has been verified here. Missing proposal and approval/effect margins remain open. These are intentional execution blockers, not permission to create a package or start a smoke run. Exact next step is review documents and obtain separate bounded implementation authorization; neither `kaggle kernels push` nor Web UI execution is a setup resume command.
